name: Leonardo.Ai
summary: Leonardo.Ai is an AI-powered creative platform for generating high-quality art, illustrations, and concept images. It offers a variety of generative models and customization tools, making it ideal for game assets, concept artists, and designers seeking unique visuals. Its intuitive interface and prompt-based generation help users create professional artwork with minimal effort.
description: Leonardo.Ai is an AI-powered creative platform for generating high-quality art, illustrations, and concept images. It offers a variety of generative models and customization tools, making it ideal for game assets, concept artists, and designers seeking unique visuals. Its intuitive interface and prompt-based generation help users create professional artwork with minimal effort. Prompt-Based Generation: Create images from text prompts. Style Customization: Choose from various artistic styles and modifiers. Batch Generation: Produce multiple variations simultaneously. Asset Library: Save and manage your generated artwork.

pricing.label: Freemium

features: Prompt-Based Generation: Create images from text prompts.
Style Customization: Choose from various artistic styles and modifiers.
Batch Generation: Produce multiple variations simultaneously.
Asset Library: Save and manage your generated artwork.

howToUse.title: Sign Up & Access Leonardo.Ai
howToUse.description: Create an account and log in to the Leonardo.Ai dashboard.

howToUse.title: Enter Prompt & Customize
howToUse.description: Input a text prompt, select styles, and adjust modifiers for your image.

howToUse.title: Generate & Save Artwork
howToUse.description: Generate images in batches, then save, manage, or share them in your asset library.

howToUse.title: Explore Community Gallery
howToUse.description: Browse and interact with other users' creations for inspiration.

features_fr: Génération basée sur des invites : créez des images à partir d'invites textuelles.
Personnalisation du style : choisissez parmi différents styles et modificateurs artistiques.
Génération par lots : produisez plusieurs variantes simultanément.
Bibliothèque d'actifs : enregistrez et gérez tes illustrations générées.
